title: Remove the dormant begin-recovery envelope modules after the begin-unknown replay lands
outcome: Once the begin-unknown replay (Option B, inside the retained evaluate) has landed, its last landing included, nothing in the tree carries the parked foundation's dormant recovery-envelope contracts. engram_recovery_format.rs and engram_recovery_validation.rs (474 lines), their tests and their wiring are removed in a pure-deletion commit with its own review pair and gate.
acceptance: src/engram_recovery_format.rs and src/engram_recovery_validation.rs, their module wiring in main.rs and tests/mod.rs, and the tests that exercise only them are deleted. The commit changes no other behaviour: it only removes lines, apart from import or registration adjustments the removal requires.

No persisted field, loader, admission caller or test outside the removed files referenced the deleted types (shown by the diff and a clean cargo check). The begin-unknown replay's tests still pass unchanged.

The commit lands after every landing of the begin-unknown reconciliation item, as its own commit with its own independent read-only Codex/Claude review pair (no outstanding Medium or higher), and the maintained five-stage full gate passes on its exact input with this item's own passed host Test record.
